facts.description: Link resolution helpers for triggers, building source links, reply chains, referenced tickets and candidate cards.

import_class.description: Imports core domain types Candidate, Ticket and Trigger.
Imports the Commands type from the infra commands module.
Imports readFeishuLink, which reads a Feishu message link.
Imports Feishu helpers feishuRef and feishuSettings.
Imports the SourceRegistry type for source lookups.
Imports triggerMessage, which renders a trigger message payload.
Imports card builders relatedTickets, ticketCard and triggerCard.
Imports the Store type for state access.
Imports the TextCache type used for cached source links.

function.function_id: src/app/links.ts:sourceLink(host: LinkHost, trigger: Trigger, signal?: AbortSignal)
function.description: Resolves a trigger's source URL, using cached links, message references and optional Feishu link enrichment.

function.function_id: src/app/links.ts:repliedTo({ store, sources }: { store: Pick<Store, 'triggers'>; sources: Pick<SourceRegistry, 'repliesTo'> }, trigger: Trigger)
function.description: Finds the parent trigger this trigger replies to, via the source registry and trigger store.

function.function_id: src/app/links.ts:referencedTickets(host: LinkHost, trigger: Trigger, known: readonly Ticket[])
function.description: Collects ticket IDs referenced in a trigger's text through threads/subscriptions, excluding known tickets, capped at 4.
Builds the candidate card payload: source link, reply context, batch triggers, handbacks, related/referenced tickets and next action.

interfaces.description: Host dependencies for link resolution: store, text cache, commands, source registry and an abort lifetime signal.
